system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Color of Caps

[Image: A pie chart indicating 30% white caps, 25% green caps, 15% black caps, 10% blue caps, and 20% red caps.]

The pie chart shows the percentage of caps for sale at a sporting goods store. If there are 200 caps, what is the total number of caps that are either white or green?

Figure, described in words:
A pie chart titled "Color of Caps" divided into five sectors: White (labeled "White 30%") occupying the top-left sector; Green (labeled "Green 25%") occupying the top-right quadrant; Red (labeled "Red 20%") occupying the bottom-right sector; Blue (labeled "Blue 10%") occupying a narrow sector at the bottom; and Black (labeled "Black 15%") occupying the sector between Blue and White on the lower left.

A. 55
B. 100
C. 110
D. 145

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
